correctness.rationale: The 81 smooth fixed-point blowups each contribute classes (1,1), (2,2), (3,3); the diagonal CM automorphism acts on H^{p,q}(E^4) by ζ^{p-q}. Rational quotient averaging, compatible with the pure Hodge structure for smooth projective Y, produces every Hodge entry. Independent Euler evaluation via finite-group fixed loci gives 297. Armstrong applies because the universal blown-up affine cover is simply connected, Γ acts properly discontinuously, and its fixed-point elements generate Γ, explicitly (λ,ρ)(0,ρ)^{-1}=(λ,1). Exact checker verifies numerical identities, not infinite theorems. Assumption: complex characteristic zero and the precisely defined Y.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural Hodge and rational Betti classification, coupled with simple connectivity, of the first explicit smooth complex four-dimensional counterexample to a longstanding effective nonvanishing conjecture. The 81 blow-up contributions and nontrivial order-three CM invariants jointly produce distinctive h^{3,0}=4, h^{4,0}=0, χ(O)=-3, b2=97, signature -75, not determined by the source’s section dimensions or Cartier-cone computation. This provides precise global topology for comparisons with other smooth birational models and characteristic-zero fourfold examples, beyond an isolated textbook identity.
